raw_segments.text: But this pre-eminence thou hast lost, brought down To dwell on even ground now with thy sons, yet doubt not but in valley, and in plain, God is, as here, and will be found alike Present, and of his presence many a sign Still following thee, still compassing thee round With goodness and paternal love, his face Express, and of his steps the track divine.
But this preeminence thou hast lost, Brought down to dwell on even ground now with thy sons.
Yet doubt not but in valley and in plain God is as here, And will be found alike present.
And of his presence many a sign still following thee, Still compassing thee round with goodness and paternal love,
His face express, and of his steps the track divine.
